powershell\manage\Start-NetworkLabMonitoringFeed.ps1

Automatisch gegenereerde weergave. Bewerk het originele bestand via de link hieronder.

Open origineel bestand
param(
    [int]$IntervalSeconds = 30,
    [int]$Iterations = 0
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$Root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)

$StatePath = Join-Path $Root "config\simulation\incident-state.json"
$DetectionLogPath = Join-Path $Root "logs\monitoring-detection.jsonl"
$RuntimeLogPath = Join-Path $Root "logs\monitoring-feed.log"

if (-not (Test-Path $StatePath)) {
    throw "Incident state file not found: $StatePath"
}

$PreviousState = "normal"
$Count = 0

Add-Content `
    -Path $RuntimeLogPath `
    -Value "[$((Get-Date).ToString('o'))] Monitoring feed started. Simulation-only mode."

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " NETWORKLAB MONITORING FEED" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Interval : $IntervalSeconds seconds" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "Mode     : SIMULATION ONLY" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "Press CTRL+C to stop." -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

while ($true) {

    $State = Get-Content $StatePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $ObservedState = [string]$State.state

    if (
        $ObservedState -eq "fault_injected" -and
        $PreviousState -ne "fault_injected"
    ) {

        $Timestamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o")

        $DetectionEvent = @{
            timestamp = $Timestamp
            event = "DETECTED"
            previous_state = $PreviousState
            observed_state = $ObservedState
            scenario = $State.scenario
            target = $State.target
            simulation = $true
            detector = "Start-NetworkLabMonitoringFeed"
        }

        $DetectionEvent |
            ConvertTo-Json -Compress |
            Add-Content -Path $DetectionLogPath -Encoding UTF8

        Add-Content `
            -Path $RuntimeLogPath `
            -Value "[$Timestamp] DETECTED simulated incident: $($State.scenario) / $($State.target)"

        Write-Host "[DETECTED] $($State.scenario) -> $($State.target)" -ForegroundColor Red
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "[$((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))] State: $ObservedState" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    $PreviousState = $ObservedState
    $Count++

    if ($Iterations -gt 0 -and $Count -ge $Iterations) {
        break
    }

    Start-Sleep -Seconds $IntervalSeconds
}
